_provenance: X API v2 403 for an OAuth 2.0 user-context token that lacks the scope the endpoint needs. Source: docs.x.com/x-api/authentication + `oauth-scopes` / `unsupported-authentication` problem family. Captured 2026-07-23. Exercises: scope class on a 403 (vs forbidden/billing), DX-F13.

body.detail: One or more of your requested scopes are missing: users.read is required.
